Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1256
Claimant:
Dawn Sims
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2023-03-29
Claim received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a traffic
signal. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
2023-03-30
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and records the
rear-end sequence consistent with the account given. The driver is named on the policy, and coverage was in force
on the loss date.
2023-06-18
Photographs submitted with the first notice of loss confirm several details of the impact. No independent witnesses
have come forward, so the photos and the police narrative are the main sources for now.
2023-07-16
Damage to the rear of the vehicle is mostly in line with the impact described. Nothing in the vehicle history or prior
claims shows earlier damage to the same area, and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2023-07-22
Claimant's counsel reports a neck strain. Reviewed the medical records, which describe a strain of a type plausible
for a collisoin of this kind. The claimant also mentioned a small strain to the same area many years ago, which the
records indicate healed fully.
2023-09-13
Treatment followed a usual course, with care tapering off as the claimant improved. The claimant has given the same
account of the collision in every conversation so far, including in the recorded statement taken through counsel.
2023-10-20
Current status: treatment is nearly complete and the claim is being evaluated against the medical documentation and
the physical evidence. Next step is to request the final treatment summary from the provider.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
